author: Ambrose

passages.original: Nativitas quoque ipsius Domini Jesu secundum carnem nonne per Spiritum sanctum facta prædicator, evangelizante Gabriele angelo Moriae, et dicente: Spiritus sanctus superveniet in te, et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi (Luc. n, 55)? et iterum Joseph angelus in somnis apparet, dicens : Josephi fili David, ne timueris accipere Mariam conjugem tuam; quod enim in ea geuerolum est, de Spiritu sancto est (Matt". I, 20)? et inde perspicuum est quia omnia et in omnibus ipse operatur et perlicil.
passages.english: Is not the birth of the Lord Jesus himself according to the flesh also proclaimed to have been brought about through the Holy Spirit, when the angel Gabriel brought the good news to Mary and said: "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you" (Luke 1:35)? And again, the angel appears to Joseph in dreams, saying: "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife; for what has been begotten in her is from the Holy Spirit" (Matt. 1:20)? And from this it is clear that he himself works and accomplishes all things and in all things.
passages.notes: Scanning errors corrected: 'prædicator' read as 'prædicatur', 'Moriae' as 'Mariae', 'geuerolum' as 'generatum', 'perlicil' as 'perficit', 'Josephi' as 'Joseph'; the reference 'Luc. n, 55' is evidently Luke 1:35.
